name: Valentin Vacherot
intro: Valentin Vacherot plays for tiny Monaco. Friends call him Val. He is the star of one of tennis's best surprise stories.
story: Val went to college in Texas. He played for Texas A&M. Last year he was ranked No. 204. Then he won the big Shanghai tournament out of nowhere! In the final he beat his own cousin, Arthur. His big brother Benjamin is his coach. This week he won two matches in New York. Next time, watch that serve!

funFacts.text: He loves pizza and pasta. His guilty pleasure is Haribo candy.
He grew up skiing before he chose tennis.
He went to college in Texas with his cousin Arthur.
He loves Formula 1 car racing and the AS Monaco soccer team.
His favorite TV show is Friends.
He beat Novak Djokovic on the way to his Shanghai title.

watchFor: Watch his serve, his favorite shot, and notice how tall he is.

notes: Birth date 1998-11-16 (age 27), 193 cm, right-handed/two-handed backhand, represents Monaco: Wikipedia confirms.
